place.name: Oviedo
place.description: Oviedo (Spanish: [oˈβjeðo] ), officially known by the bilingual name Oviedo / Uviéu (Asturian: [uˈβjew], locally Uvieo [uˈβje.o]) is the capital city of the Principality of Asturias in northern Spain, and the administrative and commercial centre of the region. With a population of 223,576, it is also the 2nd-largest city in Asturias.
